LanguageData.RSH.Ui.SleepScheduleHint: Uses local map time and can cross midnight. Bedtime and wake-up time must differ. During sleeping hours, guests stop starting leisure and shopping activities, finish any ongoing service and payment, then return to their own beds until wake-up time. Saving applies the schedule to all current guests at this hotel.
